theme: Warmth in Darkness (Dark Mode Primary with Amber Gold & Sage Warmth)
language_support: Bilingual (Bahasa Indonesia & English with header toggle)
context: LIDM 2026 (Divisi Video Digital Pendidikan) Innovation Landing Page & Parent Reflection Diagnostic Tool. Story of Rafa (17) using art to express unsaid emotions under toxic masculinity pressure, and his father discovering that listening is the ultimate support.

typography.heading_font: Cormorant Garamond, serif (or Playfair Display, serif)

rules.anti_default: STRICTLY PROHIBITED for headings: Inter, Roboto, Arial, Space Grotesk. Headings must feel editorial, warm, and deeply human.
rules.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-semibold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
rules.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight leading-snug
rules.body: text-base sm:text-lg font-sans font-light text-stone-300 leading-relaxed

key_features_and_flow.description: Fixed glassmorphism header with logo 'Ruang.', navigation links (Manifesto, Film, Tes Refleksi, Tim), language toggle (ID/EN), and primary CTA 'Mulai Tes Refleksi'.

Kinetic Hero with line-by-line masked reveal animation on load. Title: 'Suara yang Tak Terdengar di Balik Maskulinis' / 'Unspoken Voices Behind Masculinity'. Subtitle introducing Rafa's story and father-son communication. Subtle 3D/parallax ambient canvas background with floating atmospheric warm light particles.

Numbered manifesto chapters telling the narrative problem: Chapter 01 (1 in 3 Indonesian adolescents mental health crisis), Chapter 02 (70% suicide rate among men & toxic masculinity 'anak laki jangan menangis'), Chapter 03 (Ruang: A quiet room for father and son connection).
Cinematic YouTube spotlight featuring embedded short film (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bcGpVvJwYKw) with custom theatrical frame, video synopsis, and LIDM 2026 digital video context.

Interactive 12-question 'Tes Refleksi Orang Tua' based on IPARTheory (Parental Acceptance-Rejection Theory). Interactive step-by-step branching feel UX, scale response 1-4, real-time progress bar, immediate psychological insight result screen showing score breakdown across 4 dimensions: Warmth/Affection (Kehangatan), Hostility/Aggression (Permusuhan), Indifference/Neglect (Ketikpedulian), and Undifferentiated Rejection (Penolakan Tanpa Alasan), along with personalized actionable advice for fathers/parents.

Slow, organic editorial marquee banner drifting quietly across screen with key quotes: 'Mendengar adalah Bentuk Cinta Tertinggi' / 'Listening is the Highest Form of Love' • 'Ruang Bicara Tanpa Penghakiman'.

LIDM 2026 Team showcase with profile cards: Shelly Alfidenia (Ketua / Leader), Aji Sulaksana (Anggota / Member), Egazia Evanggelis (Anggota / Member), Falyanzuril Ihsan (Anggota / Member), and Dosen Pembimbing: Dr. Lailatur Rahmi.
LIDM 2026 Contextual footer with competition details (Divisi Video Digital Pendidikan), copyright, social links, and rapid jump navigation.

ipar_theory_questions.text_id: Saya sering memeluk atau memberikan pujian hangat ketika anak saya berhasil melakukan sesuatu.
ipar_theory_questions.text_en: I often hug or give warm praise when my child accomplishes something.

ipar_theory_questions.text_id: Saya mudah hilang kesabaran dan membentak anak ketika dia melakukan kesalahan kecil.
ipar_theory_questions.text_en: I easily lose my patience and yell at my child over minor mistakes.

ipar_theory_questions.text_id: Saya merasa terlalu lelah untuk mendengarkan cerita keseharian anak saya.
ipar_theory_questions.text_en: I feel too exhausted to listen to my child's daily stories.

ipar_theory_questions.text_id: Kadang saya merasa anak saya hanya menjadi beban dalam hidup saya.
ipar_theory_questions.text_en: Sometimes I feel my child is just a burden in my life.

ipar_theory_questions.text_id: Saya berusaha meluangkan waktu khusus setiap minggu hanya untuk mengobrol berdua dengan anak.
ipar_theory_questions.text_en: I make an effort to spend dedicated 1-on-1 time chatting with my child every week.

ipar_theory_questions.text_id: Saya menuntut anak laki-laki saya untuk selalu kuat dan melarangnya menangis.
ipar_theory_questions.text_en: I demand my son to always be strong and forbid him from crying.

ipar_theory_questions.text_id: Saya jarang mengetahui apa yang dirasakan atau digambar oleh anak saya di kamarnya.
ipar_theory_questions.text_en: I rarely know what my child is feeling or drawing in his room.

ipar_theory_questions.text_id: Saya merasa sulit untuk bersikap ramah atau menunjukkan rasa sayang secara fisik kepada anak.
ipar_theory_questions.text_en: I find it difficult to be affectionate or show physical love to my child.

ipar_theory_questions.text_id: Ketika anak saya sedih, saya mendengarkan tanpa langsung menyalahkan atau menceramahi.
ipar_theory_questions.text_en: When my child is sad, I listen without immediately blaming or lecturing.

ipar_theory_questions.text_id: Saya sering membandingkan anak saya dengan anak lain yang tampak lebih maskulin atau sukses.
ipar_theory_questions.text_en: I often compare my child to others who seem more masculine or successful.

ipar_theory_questions.text_id: Saya menganggap masalah emosional anak remaja sebagai hal yang berlebihan atau cari perhatian.
ipar_theory_questions.text_en: I view my adolescent child's emotional issues as exaggeration or attention-seeking.

ipar_theory_questions.text_id: Saya siap belajar memahami bahasa emosi baru yang ditunjukkan oleh anak saya.
ipar_theory_questions.text_en: I am ready to learn to understand the new emotional language shown by my child.

motion_and_effects.smooth_scroll: Lenis Smooth Scroll engine enabled globally across the page
motion_and_effects.animations: Framer Motion line reveal on load for hero, staggered fade-in up for manifesto chapters, smooth scale transition for video player embed, interactive step wizard transition for test steps
motion_and_effects.micro_interactions: Subtle button glow on hover, border light bleed, ripple on reflection scale select
motion_and_effects.prefers_reduced_motion: Ensure all animations fallback to standard instant opacity when reduced motion is requested

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_policy: All key components and interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.rule_1: Never center-align body text or long paragraphs. Keep left-aligned for natural human reading flow.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.rule_2: Use 2-3x generous padding inside bordered containers to avoid text touching borders (e.g. p-6, p-8).
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.rule_3: Do not use generic card grids. Use asymmetrical swiss layouts and textured dark surfaces with subtle warm borders.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.rule_4: Do not use raw transparent backgrounds in navigation header or modals. Use backdrop-blur-md bg-stone-950/80.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.rule_5: Ensure all interactive hover states explicitly define text color changes (e.g., hover:bg-amber-500 hover:text-stone-950).
